svg.title: Logarithms turn difficult multiplication into easier addition
svg.desc: Logarithmic differentiation is useful because logs transform products into sums, quotients into differences, and exponents into coefficients before differentiation. The original expression contains a quotient, powers, a radical, and an exponential. Taking logarithms separates those structures. After expansion, each term can be differentiated with familiar rules. The final step, not shown in the last box, is to multiply by y and replace y with the original expression. Logarithmic differentiation is useful because logs transform products into sums, quotients into differences, and exponents into coefficients before differentiation. The original expression contains a quotient, powers, a radical, and an exponential. Taking logarithms separates those structures. After expansion, each term can be differentiated with familiar rules. The final step, not shown in the last box, is to multiply by y and replace y with the original expression. The visual uses labeled positions, solid and dashed line styles, and written descriptions so logarithms turn difficult multiplication into easier addition does not depend on color. Caption: Logarithmic differentiation is useful because logs transform products into sums, quotients into differences, and exponents into coefficients before differentiation. Reading order: original-box: Labeled box: 1. Original product, quotient, powers, and radical.; take-log-box: Labeled box: 2. Apply ln to both sides.; expand-box: Labeled box: 3. Expand: products become sums; powers become coefficients.; differentiate-box: Labeled box: 4. Differentiate, solve for y', and substitute y back.; v1-arrow: Arrow preserves the instructional reading order.; v2-arrow: Arrow preserves the instructional reading order.; v3-arrow: Arrow preserves the instructional reading order.; original-label: Written label identifies 1. Original product, quotient, powers, and radical.; take-log-label: Written label identifies 2. Apply ln to both sides.; expand-label: Written label identifies 3. Expand: products become sums; powers become coefficients.; differentiate-label: Written label identifies 4. Differentiate, solve for y', and substitute y back..
